# Boolean seed callback

An original two-formal generic method relates a bounded carrier pair, one
Object-bound seed, a Boolean flag, a callback consuming the same carrier pair
and a completion accepting the callback's closed Unit result. No bytecode or
metadata is rewritten. SDK declarations can be borrowed independently.

Frozen direct, precompiled, reflection and method-handle callers compare both
Boolean branches, reference identity and nulls, nominal bounds with wide
values, ordered provider reads, the callback's original cast and completion
failures. Four incorrect programs change the callback input, Boolean result,
result publication or effect order and must fail the observer.
